long/COVERAGE_HUNTER.scope: deduplicated union across validated latest observed key sets, including valid partial episodes; not per-episode medians or total possible gameplay coverage

long/RANDOM.scope: deduplicated union across validated latest observed key sets, including valid partial episodes; not per-episode medians or total possible gameplay coverage

deduplicated_observed_coverage_unions.missing_rule: an empty observed cohort is unknown, not zero; observed unions with missing episodes are only lower bounds on what the planned cohort might have observed

limits: This is exactly eight long episodes: construction initial fixture, seed1701, RANDOM and COVERAGE_HUNTER at128/256/512/1024 attempted slots. There is one planned observation per policy/budget; no replicated uncertainty estimate or statistical significance is available.
This programme does not include the108 matched baseline cases, the16-personality cohort or the10-scenario cohort. Empty matched results are not observations or estimates.
The initial fixture is fixed. Subsequent ordinary world replacement is strategy behavior; actual fixture identities and replacement rows are reported.
Missing observations stay unknown. Completed/admitted actions, admitted partial actions, refusals and retained in-flight proposals are distinct; a requested budget is not an observed action count.
All long profiles start fresh without corpus imports. The separate seven-process memory experiment must retain its own exact source, costs, outcomes and selected seeds.
Per-episode metrics are primary. A pooled policy timing distribution mixes four requested horizons and is descriptive; it is not an equal-budget policy contrast.
First/last64 windows use requested attempt ordinals. An unobserved late window stays missing; incomplete episodes cannot establish completion or long-horizon degradation.

Row timings use unchanged adapter pipeline definitions, including waits and synchronous admission-evidence checkpoints. Action arguments, material/actor state, ordinary replacement and growing evidence writes confound timing comparisons.
Frame p95 is the recorded per-episode aggregate, not pooled frame p95 or an independently reconstructed quantile. Raw chronological frames are not retained and the50000-sample cap is explicit.

Controller elapsed time ends before final export/close. Process wall time includes startup and close; summed process cost excludes import and other qualification overhead. Sampled RSS is not an allocation invariant or a continuous growth curve.

Coverage unions deduplicate validated observed keys, including partial episodes, and are lower bounds when episodes are missing. They are not per-episode medians or a fraction of all possible gameplay conditions.

Cross-source comparison may join only on cohort, initial fixture, policy, seed and budget while preserving each original ID and execution order. Standalone long8 IDs/order differ from the long cohort inside a142-episode plan.

The repaired source uses adapterv3/state-v2 zero_tick instead of the historical adapterv2/state-v1 authored_start namespace. The applicability repair and witness metadata also differ. Unchanged policy weights do not prove identical choices or causal improvement; state-key sets must not be pooled across these namespaces.

Automatic findings and candidate bundles remain triage. Confirmed defects, replay and reduction success require their separately reviewed cases. No physical GPU, exact asynchronous checkpoint, chemical reaction or completed actor route is inferred.

# GIP-014-goblin-002 — final 6f Linux exploration readout

## Exact source and evidence

The frozen readers validate the retained **6f Linux long8 and memory7 evidence**. This is a source-specific supplement to the earlier full 142-episode 5ee comparison. The original native Linux qualification remains failed: four long episodes did not reach their requested attempt budgets. The later passive analysis succeeds as a read-only data review.

- Gameplay source: `6f359ce2b24291ee219810773c641d53802fd31d`; tree `a4f389cd3cc1a21dfe3d5566703eb946b66734ed`.
- Original run/job: `45565621408 / 139039653373`; artifact `15003384515`, 50,241,858 bytes, SHA-256 `c5ab54aa45062bf12912e29743058019bc1db38ae59c0a4b234172d6b371fe6e`.
- Passive review: run/job `45579669046 / 139086236044`, driver `2a627a3131be72fcb876acec0d0b848a7e42c3e3`. Its full job log is Git blob `7e99bc3d49a24ee31c9c87872063d664de2d5b33`.
- Long report: 1,040,902 bytes, SHA-256 `c32ab2dcbd84f969a8dff36c9e0b31122a0e7664e70516d7fc0334d9046306dd`.
- Memory report: 123,204 bytes, SHA-256 `6d60a463843c99ba3eb1cb30596ed7d0085f5314de77f1fb4e4df9dfdc565ccb`.
- Complete restored stage: artifact `15005776720`, 942,877,571 bytes, SHA-256 `8621cf2811e14fdda3e98749f84b7d0887228f0c64b91967ae67485627552da9`. It retains the full reports, original artifacts and frozen reader bytes.

The exact long reader remains blob `fe0b8a5c522f3495dfdf7d9f43690c07d73a60d2`, SHA-256 `9685d368f7a776c73c1a47c31e05b73d88990791dff69d9d3266ba42c17bd621`. Its source and metrics were frozen before outcomes. Memory uses the unchanged eleven-module closure. The owner record and ledger both pass the separate source preflight with no missing fields. The primary reader takes 6.385 seconds with sampled peak RSS 185,708,544 bytes; memory reanalysis takes 1.046 seconds with 70,897,664 bytes. Neither launches the game or leaves an owned process. The 25 additional arithmetic/source checks in this readout verify consistency of existing report fields; they are not gameplay tests or new metrics.

## Eight long episodes

All eight registered tapes and coverage records validate. They contain **2,858 attempted actions, 2,847 admitted and completed actions, 11 refusals and zero partial admitted actions**, out of 3,840 planned attempt slots. Four episodes reach their budgets: both policies at 128 and 256. The other four retain `campaign_timeout`, `test_failure` and `unresolved_observation` in their original records. None has a recorded failed row assertion or pending action. The table is grouped for display; original IDs and execution order remain in the full report.

| Policy | Budget | Attempted | Completed | Refused | Original terminal | Process seconds |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- | ---: |
| Random | 128 | 128 | 128 | 0 | budget_complete | 82.765 |
| Coverage Hunter | 128 | 128 | 128 | 0 | budget_complete | 57.475 |
| Random | 256 | 256 | 254 | 2 | budget_complete | 258.265 |
| Coverage Hunter | 256 | 256 | 255 | 1 | budget_complete | 191.335 |
| Random | 512 | 436 | 434 | 2 | campaign_timeout | 622.892 |
| Coverage Hunter | 512 | 501 | 499 | 2 | campaign_timeout | 622.547 |
| Random | 1024 | 537 | 535 | 2 | campaign_timeout | 909.588 |
| Coverage Hunter | 1024 | 616 | 614 | 2 | campaign_timeout | 909.762 |

This source has **no completed 512- or 1024-attempt episode** in the fixed programme. The longest observed tape contains 616 attempts and 614 completed actions. All eight process receipts contribute to 3,654.629 seconds of observed process cost, with maximum sampled tree RSS 881,831,936 bytes. Costs include start/close and exclude separate import/qualification work; sampled RSS is not an allocation or leak oracle.

Deduplicated observed unions across all eight tapes, including their valid incomplete prefixes, are: **51 action IDs; 593 action-transition keys; 1,129 state-transition keys; 43 material-interaction keys; 46 tool/material keys; 62 actor/environment keys; 8 lifecycle keys; 1 boundary/refusal key; and 66 outcome keys.** No dimension reports saturation. These are observed key unions, not a percentage of all gameplay conditions. The initial fixture is construction, but the policies use ordinary replacement; each 512/1024 tape observes all ten fixture identities. This is not fixed-environment exposure.

Requested last-64 windows remain incomplete where appropriate: Coverage Hunter512 observes 53 of its requested final64 rows; Random512 and both1024 trials observe none. Missing late windows are not completed trajectories. Recorded whole-process frame intervals include startup/fixture work: p95 values range from 7.026 to 9.470 milliseconds, while the largest recorded interval is 20.313099 seconds. These aggregates do not isolate engine FPS or checkpoint cost. Action-pipeline times include native waits and synchronous evidence work; no causal degradation or leak finding follows from them.

## Seven memory episodes

The separate experiment completes **all seven episodes and all 448 admitted actions**, with no refusals or partial actions. CONTROL64 cultivation runs once. Its frozen corpus has SHA-256 `a49f4d4dc5957da993a0486ff9d14db2685acd24a059060f5efa8114292f34a4`. The retained four-action prefix ranks 1 among 54 eligible candidates, selecting seeds 65 and 129 before either measured outcome. Each measured arm uses a fresh marked profile and the same cultivation corpus; measured output is not fed into later arms.

| Seed | Arm | Completed | Action IDs | Material keys | State keys | Retained inputs proposed |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 65 | Fresh | 64 | 28 | 10 | 64 | 0 |
| 65 | Hints only | 64 | 26 | 10 | 64 | 0 |
| 65 | Explicit prefix | 64 | 26 | 9 | 64 | 4 |
| 129 | Fresh | 64 | 27 | 5 | 62 | 0 |
| 129 | Hints only | 64 | 30 | 3 | 64 | 0 |
| 129 | Explicit prefix | 64 | 28 | 5 | 64 | 4 |

Both explicit-prefix arms queue **four**, propose **four**, and complete the exact retained inputs: Pause; camera rectangle `[0,0,480,270]`; select material58; rectangle `[32,32]..[39,39]`. Independent source-fenced material captures show the same 64 cells changing from Empty to material58. This is actual action-prefix reuse, not physical-checkpoint restoration. Fresh and hints-only arms propose zero retained-prefix actions.

The hints-only mechanism also changes an actual choice in both seeds at the first action, while the initial abstract state and paused native identities match. Seed65 changes from Outline to Brush; seed129 changes from Select-tool to Brush-radius. Later states and ordinary fixture replacements diverge, so the entire subsequent trajectories are not treated as identical physical conditions.

Coverage benefit remains mixed. Hints minus fresh gives action-ID differences **−2/+3**, material-key differences **0/−2**, and state-key differences **0/+2** at seeds65/129. Explicit prefix minus fresh gives action-ID differences **−2/+1**, material-key differences **−1/0**, and state-key differences **0/+2**. Imported observations receive no current-episode coverage credit; the full report separately retains new-key differences after subtracting cultivation keys. Useful reproduction does not imply greater novelty.

Cultivation costs 21.496 seconds and is included in the 188.301-second sum of all seven game processes. The supervisor takes 199.883 seconds and peaks at 780,529,664 sampled RSS bytes, with no surviving owned process. Its one import takes 6.637 seconds. No amortized search or speed benefit is presumed.

## Scientific scope and handover

There is one initial construction seed per policy/budget in long8 and two adaptively selected seeds from one cultivated corpus in memory7. These observations establish functioning persisted hints and exact action-prefix reuse on the final source, plus useful bounded long-run evidence. They do not establish a population effect, a policy ranking, a production gameplay defect, an exact asynchronous replay checkpoint or a completed1024 guarantee.

The earlier full 5ee matrix remains the matched policy comparison. Its 142 episodes and State-v1 keys are not pooled with this State-v2 supplement. The corrected source uses adapter-v3 observations and `zero_tick`, and its material-lineage applicability/witness metadata differs; unchanged policy weights alone do not establish identical paths or a causal performance comparison. The standalone eight-episode execution order also differs from the long cohort inside a142-episode queue.

The original deadline records remain available for B's independent terminal-contract adjudication. The separately qualified Windows evaluator still executes the exact6f source. Draft/HOLD, no default activation, no merge/Ready promotion, and no physical NVIDIA acceptance remain unchanged. The complete six original predecessor Linux tape bodies lost with the local host are not reconstructed by this analysis; their surviving metadata and the separately verified original Windows artifacts remain explicitly distinguished in the passive archive.
